svg.title: TCSA database entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Nine tables and ten foreign keys from migrations 001 to 003. Optional references are history author, task completer and audit task. Carer name is plain text. At most one active admission per animal is enforced by a generated unique field.

g.text: Current schema from migrations 001–003 · 9 tables · 60 columns · 10 foreign keys
System support tables · no foreign-key relationships
At most one active admission per animal.
carer_name is text, not a staff foreign key.
Foreign keys use restrictive deletion; no cascades.
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UK = unique key NULL = optional value generated = derived column
Crow’s foot = many circle = zero allowed double bar = exactly one dashed line = non-identifying relationship
Schema review: 27 October 2026 · No account details, credentials or animal records are included.
